description: P4 reasoning templates (decision ledger S08_pre_implementation_decisions.md section 3). Three segments (perception / risk / decision), 3-5 wording variants each; the variant is selected deterministically by hash(sample_token + segment salt) so the same input always renders byte-identical text. Variants only change wording, never information: object categories come from critical_objects, risk phrases come from enum_phrase_map.json verbatim, decision wording comes from the speed_action/yield phrases. English only, no distance/speed numbers, zero traffic-light mentions (P4.4). Placeholders: {objects} = comma list of '{article} {motion_phrase} {category}' items, {risks} = comma list of fixed risk phrases, {speed_action} / {yield_phrase} = fixed phrases from enum_phrase_map.json.

variants: In front of me, I can see {objects}.
empty_variants: Ahead of me, I cannot see any objects.
There are no objects visible in front of me.
I do not observe any objects ahead.
Nothing notable is visible ahead of me.
I do not identify any immediate risks.
The situation appears free of immediate risks.

variants: Given this, my action is to {speed_action}, and {yield_phrase}.
